title: Modify menu: Swap Symbol and Distribute to Layers
description: Two commonly-used Flash 8 Modify operations are missing: (1) 'Swap Symbol...' — when a symbol instance is selected, opens a dialog to pick a different library symbol to replace it with (same position/transform); implement SwapSymbolDialog.tsx and wire into Modify menu. (2) 'Distribute to Layers' — takes multiple selected display objects on one layer and puts each on its own new layer; implement the model mutation and wire into Modify menu.
